summary: Computes the ratio (a2 - 1.0) / divisor for a two-float result pair. If the supplied divisor a3 is not positive (a3 <= 0.0) the divisor is clamped to FLT_MAX (3.4028235e38) to avoid a division-by-zero or negative-divisor hazard; the clamped divisor is stored to this+0x04 and the computed ratio to this+0x00. Called per-frame by sub_4F18C0 (004f18c0).

local_names.this: two-float output record storing the ratio at +0x00 and the clamped divisor at +0x04
local_names.a2: numerator operand; the ratio is computed against a2 - 1.0
local_names.a3: proposed divisor, replaced by FLT_MAX when not positive
local_names.v3: effective divisor after the threshold clamp

operations.description: Divisor clamp: when a3 <= 0.0 the effective divisor becomes FLT_MAX (3.4028235e38), otherwise it stays a3; both branches assign the result to v3
Stores the (possibly clamped) effective divisor to this[1] at byte offset +0x04
Computes (a2 - 1.0) divided by the effective divisor and stores the ratio to this[0] at byte offset +0x00
